mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate indicates an accommodative monetary policy, which stimulates economic growth and increases S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative returns in 60% of the 20-day windows following low FEDFUNDS, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate signals a weak labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive returns in 60% of the 20-day windows when UNRATE is above 7%, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: Strong payroll growth combined with low unemployment indicates a robust labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative returns in 60% of the 60-day windows with strong PAYEMS and low UNRATE, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: Slowing industrial production growth in a late-cycle expansion signals reduced corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive returns in 60% of the 60-day windows with slowing INDPRO in late-cycle, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate indicates a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative returns in 60% of the 5-day windows with low UNRATE, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in consumer price index above the central bank's target indicates inflationary pressures, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive returns in 60% of the 20-day windows when CPIAUCSL is above target, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: Strong GDP growth combined with high housing starts indicates robust demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative returns in 60% of the 60-day windows with strong GDPC1 and HOUST, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: Rising federal funds rate in a tightening cycle increases borrowing costs, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive returns in 60% of the 20-day windows during monetary tightening, the hypothesis is rejected.
